valo_staff_expiry_shape.name: valo_staff_expiry_shape
valo_staff_expiry_shape.value: ("valo_staff_assignments"."grant_mode" = 'permanent' AND "valo_staff_assignments"."expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("valo_staff_assignments"."grant_mode" = 'break_glass' AND "valo_staff_assignments"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_staff_assignments"."expires_at" >= "valo_staff_assignments"."granted_at" + interval '5 minutes' AND "valo_staff_assignments"."expires_at" <= "valo_staff_assignments"."granted_at" + interval '60 minutes')

result_scope.name: result_scope
result_scope.default: 'No result has been prepared or provider action confirmed.'

valo_support_case_source.name: valo_support_case_source
valo_support_case_source.value:
("valo_support_cases"."source_kind"='workspace' AND "valo_support_cases"."ticket_id" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_support_cases"."access_id" IS NULL AND "valo_support_cases"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("valo_support_cases"."source_kind"='access' AND "valo_support_cases"."access_id" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_support_cases"."ticket_id" IS NULL AND "valo_support_cases"."workspace_id" IS NULL)

valo_workspace_exports_check.name: valo_workspace_exports_check
valo_workspace_exports_check.value: "valo_workspace_exports"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("valo_workspace_exports"."checksum" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_workspace_exports"."size" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_workspace_exports"."current_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_workspace_exports"."counts" IS NOT NULL)
